t: What Infrastructure Lifecycle Database Is All About
title: What Infrastructure Lifecycle Database Is All About
description: Infrastructure lifecycle is cradle to grave: design life (bridges 75-100 years, pavements 20-40), deterioration curves, maintenance timing, and replacement cost. Life-cycle cost analysis (LCCA) compares options by total cost — the cheap build is often the expensive asset. ASCE's C- grade reflects deferred maintenance. The asset management standard (ISO 55000) runs it as a discipline: inventory, condition, risk, plan. This database is the complete lifecycle record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Infrastructure Lifecycle Database: a complete reference database of full lifecycle record records.
